purpose: Teach: 芥川/ビルマ/ベネズエラ/茅ヶ崎/ナイロビ/鈴鹿/ホノルル/テレビ東京

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、芥川賞作家のサイン会に行かれたって、メイちゃん
lines.en: That customer of yours took Aoi to an Akutagawa Prize author's book signing, didn't they?
lines.style: Warm, noticing tone. Speaking with gentle discovery, as if piecing together something about someone Aoi cares about. Soft, conversational pace. The pleasure of sharing an observation.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ビルマ時代の祖父のお話されたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: That customer told Aoi about their grandfather's time in Burma, remember?
lines.style: Reflective, almost musing. Quiet certainty—recalling a detail that stayed with her. Slight pause before the memory crystallizes. Tender undercurrent.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ベネズエラの民族音楽がお好きだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: That customer really loves Venezuelan folk music, you know.
lines.style: Gentle discovery in the voice. Speaking as if confirming something beautiful about this person. Unhurried. The tone of someone noticing depths in others.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、茅ヶ崎のサーフスポットに通われてるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: That customer surfs regularly at Chigasaki—they go back all the time.
lines.style: Soft appreciation. A detail that rounds out the picture. Calm, even pace. No rush to the sentence.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ナイロビへの取材経験がおありだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: That customer has actually done reporting in Nairobi, they told Aoi.
lines.style: Quiet respect beneath the surface. Speaking with the slight awe of recognizing someone's lived experience. Measured pace. Genuine.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、鈴鹿サーキットのF1観戦が趣味だって、メイちゃん
lines.en: That customer watches F1 at Suzuka Circuit—it's their hobby.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact fondness. The tone of cataloging someone's passion without judgment. Steady, conversational rhythm.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ホノルル旅行のお土産下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: That customer brought Aoi back a souvenir from Honolulu—wasn't that thoughtful?
lines.style: Pleased recognition, with a note of warmth. The voice brightens slightly. Acknowledging kindness noticed. Genuine smile underneath the words.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、テレビ東京のドキュメンタリーが好きだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: That customer loves Tele Tokyo documentaries, apparently.
lines.style: Reflective final thought, closing gently. Quieter than before, settling into the picture of this person. A trailing-off quality, like the last piece clicking into place.
